summary: Graf Global Corp., a Cayman Islands blank-check company listed on NYSE American, filed an 8-K on September 29, 2026 reporting that its board elected on September 27, 2026 to extend the deadline to consummate an initial business combination by one month, from September 27, 2026 to October 27, 2026. The amended articles permit up to three one-month extensions, to as late as December 27, 2026. No target, price, premium, advisor or financing terms were disclosed. Watch for further extension or liquidation risk and trust redemption dynamics.
